package_downloads_definition: Cumulative downloads of all versions of the extension package, not users or Persona installations.
intro: Extensions add capabilities to Persona, like new connectors and voice chat. Built-in ones, ones in manager.json and ones installed on the hub machine are all listed here.
title: Extensions
list_footer: Extensions are installed, upgraded and removed in the hub's admin page (/admin) or on the hub machine (personad extension). Here you can turn them on or off, change settings and enter secrets.
list_footer_market: Extensions from a market are managed here. Others are installed, upgraded and removed in the hub's admin page (/admin) or on the hub machine (personad extension).
empty_detail: Install extensions in the hub's admin page (/admin) or with personad extension install on the hub machine, then turn them on and set them up here.
market_footer: A market is an index of extensions published by a website or GitHub repository. Search, install and upgrade here; extensions installed from a market can be removed here too.
upgrade_footer: When the market has a new version, it's installed while the extension is idle. If it asks for more permissions, you're asked first. A version that fails to start rolls back to the previous one.
upgrade_paused_footer: Auto-upgrade is paused while this extension is off. Turn the extension back on and your auto-upgrade setting applies again.
read_only: This extension is set in its assistant's manager.json. Turn it on or off and change its settings there or in the admin page, then restart the assistant.
enable_footer: When off, this extension's capabilities are unavailable. Your configuration is kept.
enable_footer_pack: Turning the pack off turns off its members too, and they stop running. Turning it back on turns on the members it turned off; a member you turn on or off yourself stays as you set it.
enable_footer_pack_off: Turning the pack back on turns on {names} again. A member you turn on or off yourself stays as you set it.
enable_footer_pack_alone: Turning the pack off turns off only the pack itself. Turn each member on or off on its own page.
disable_pack_body: Its members are turned off too: {names}. They're only turned off, not removed; settings and data are kept. Turning the pack back on turns them on again.
pages_footer: The extension draws these pages and handles their buttons.
secrets_footer: Secrets are stored encrypted on the hub and given only to this extension. Once saved they're never shown again; you can only replace or clear them.
depends_footer: Install and turn on these extensions before using this one.
pack_footer: When removing a pack, you can remove just the pack or its members too.
contributions_footer: Turning one off leaves everything else as it is. Items that follow a connector are changed in that connector's settings; items that follow the extension's settings, in the settings above.
permissions_footer: You agreed to these when installing. If a new version asks for more, you'll be asked again before upgrading.
market_installed_footer: This extension came from a market. After removing it, you can install it again from the market.
disable_dependents_title: Turn off “{name}” and the extensions that depend on it?
dependents_body: These extensions use it: {names}. They're only turned off, not removed; settings and data are kept.
not_a_number: A field isn't a number. Fix it to save.
no_mac: No Macs on this hub yet.
no_machine: No machines on this hub yet.
secret_replace_placeholder: Enter a new value to replace
secret_hint: Stored on the hub and given only to this extension.
sandbox_footer: The sandbox only isolates installed extensions the hub runs; the state above is what actually applies. Change it only on the hub machine or in the admin page.
externally_managed: This extension is managed at its source. Change its settings there.
builtin_uninstall: Built-in extensions cannot be uninstalled. Turn the extension off instead.
builtin_updates: Built-in extensions are updated with Persona.
external_uninstall: This extension is managed outside the extension market. Remove it at its source.
external_updates: This extension is not managed by an extension market. Update it at its source.
action_unknown: This assistant does not provide this action.
market_unavailable: The extension market is unavailable. Try checking again later.
market_extension_missing: This extension is no longer listed in its market. Its installed version is kept.
market_removed: Auto-upgrade is paused because its market was removed. Your setting is kept and applies again once the market is added back with the same address.
market_removed_check: Its market was removed. Add the market again with the same address to check for new versions.
check_updates_hint: Check the extension market for a new version. Nothing is installed without confirmation.
global_upgrade_off: Auto-upgrade is paused because automatic extension updates are off for this assistant. Your setting is kept and applies again once they're turned back on.
manager_offline: This extension's assistant is offline. Reconnect it to make changes.
reference_hint: Its provider gives the value whenever this extension needs it. Persona keeps only the reference.
users_footer: These settings take their values from this provider. Saving a setting lets it keep taking its value.
rules_footer: An Agent with this launcher on this computer gets the value without asking, when you start it yourself.
rule_remove_body: The next time {launcher} on {machine} asks for it, you approve it again.
